description: You've joined a team and found a mysterious utility function 'sanitize_user_input()' with variations across multiple files. Comments mention 'the 2019 injection bug' but no one remembers details. Conduct code archaeology to understand its history and current state. GOAL: Create a file '/home/ga/workspace/ARCHAEOLOGY_REPORT.md' with three sections: (1) Historical Context - when was it introduced, why, original commit message; (2) Current State - all file locations where it exists, where it's used, test coverage status; (3) Recommendation - should it be kept, refactored, or removed. Use Git commands (git log, git blame, git show) and VSCode features (Find All References, Find in Files, Go to Definition) to investigate thoroughly.
